newsitem.title: CHINA: China March non-ferrous metals output up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: China March non-ferrous metals output up 10 pct.

text.p: China's total output of 10 major non-ferrous metals was up more than 10 percent in March compared with the previous month, the Shanghai Securities News said on Friday.
Total output of 10 non-ferrous metals in March was 421,000 tonnes, up 11.4 percent from February, it said, quoting figures from the State Statistical Bureau.
The accumulated January-March total output was 1.1619 million tonnes, up 14.8 percent compared with the same 1996 period, it said.
